objects.description: No structs, enums, typedefs, or classes are defined in this header. It only declares the C function tmux_public_sum. There are therefore no custom data types to document.

functions.name: tmux_public_sum
functions.description: Computes and returns the sum of two integers. Expected usage: call with two int values to obtain a + b. No additional side effects or state are implied by the header; details beyond simple addition are unknown due to lack of documentation.
requirements: Arguments a and b must be initialized C int values.
The sum a + b must be representable in the range of int (INT_MIN..INT_MAX) to avoid signed overflow.
Callers in C++ should include the header as provided to use the extern "C" linkage; no special initialization or teardown is required.
